messages.subject: GWR model with INLA
parts:
Hi

Is there a way to fit a geographically weighted regression model with INLA?

Thanks in advance and all the best,
Hossein

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] GWR model with INLA
parts:
Hi,

you have to code this yourself using 'generic0', since the precision
matrix is just a scaling of a fixed matrix.

there is no current support for constructing this matrix

Best
H
